title: Data residency & compliance
subtitle: Where your monitoring data lives, how it moves, and how the platform is designed to support Saudi regulatory expectations.

hero.title: Your monitoring data never leaves the Kingdom
hero.body: Metrics, logs, alerts, configuration snapshots and user activity are collected, processed, stored and backed up exclusively in data centers located in Saudi Arabia. Support engineers who can access your tenant are based in the Kingdom.
hero.illustrative: Illustrative placeholder content for market validation

dc.title: Hosting locations
dc.dc1Desc: Primary processing, storage and the web console. Central region.
dc.dc2Desc: Synchronous replica for disaster recovery. Western region.
dc.mapNote: Data center locations are shown for illustration; final facilities will be confirmed with pilot customers.

flow.title: How your data flows
flow.subtitle: Every hop stays inside Saudi Arabia
flow.s1d: Lightweight agents and SNMP/syslog collectors run on-premises at your sites.
flow.s2d: TLS 1.3 over in-Kingdom carrier links or a private VPN to the platform.
flow.s3d: Riyadh DC1 — time-series, logs and alerts, encrypted at rest.
flow.s4d: Continuous replication to Jeddah DC2. No replicas abroad.
flow.s5d: Role-based access, MFA and a full audit trail of every action.

principles.title: Residency & security principles
principles.p1: No telemetry, crash reports or usage analytics are sent outside the Kingdom.
principles.p2: Encryption keys are managed in-Kingdom; customer-managed keys available on Enterprise.
principles.p3: Configurable retention per data type, with verifiable deletion on request.
principles.p4: Personal data in logs can be masked at the collector before it leaves your network.
principles.p5: Every console and API action is recorded in a tamper-evident audit log.
principles.p6: Optional dedicated tenant or on-premises deployment for highly regulated entities.

frameworks.title: Regulatory alignment
frameworks.subtitle: Control areas the platform is designed to support. Each item notes whether it is supported by the platform, shared with your team, or remains your responsibility.
frameworks.ncaFull: National Cybersecurity Authority — Essential Cybersecurity Controls
frameworks.samaFull: Saudi Central Bank — Cyber Security Framework (financial entities)

nca-assets.title: Asset management
nca-assets.desc: Automatic discovery and an up-to-date inventory of network, server and facility assets.

nca-logging.title: Cybersecurity event logs & monitoring
nca-logging.desc: Centralised collection, retention and search of security-relevant logs from all sites.

nca-incident.title: Incident & threat management
nca-incident.desc: Alerting, escalation and timelines that feed your incident response process.

nca-network.title: Network security management
nca-network.desc: Monitoring of firewall health, configuration changes and unexpected interface activity.

nca-iam.title: Identity & access management
nca-iam.desc: Role-based access, MFA, SSO and periodic access review exports for the console.

nca-backup.title: Backup & recovery management
nca-backup.desc: Visibility of backup job success, failures and repository capacity.

nca-cloud.title: Third-party & cloud cybersecurity
nca-cloud.desc: Service hosted entirely in Saudi Arabia with documented security responsibilities.

nca-resilience.title: Cybersecurity resilience
nca-resilience.desc: In-Kingdom disaster recovery site and availability reporting for business continuity.

nca-vuln.title: Vulnerability management
nca-vuln.desc: Scanning remains with your tooling; integrations to correlate findings are on the roadmap.

pdpl-residency.title: Data processed inside the Kingdom
pdpl-residency.desc: All monitoring data is processed and stored in Saudi data centers.

pdpl-transfer.title: Cross-border transfer controls
pdpl-transfer.desc: No replication, backup or support access from outside Saudi Arabia.

pdpl-minimization.title: Data minimisation
pdpl-minimization.desc: Collector-side masking of personal data (e.g. national ID, mobile numbers) in logs.

pdpl-retention.title: Retention & deletion
pdpl-retention.desc: Per-type retention policies with automatic, auditable deletion.

pdpl-breach.title: Breach detection support
pdpl-breach.desc: Alerts and evidence exports that support your breach notification workflow.

pdpl-rights.title: Data subject requests
pdpl-rights.desc: Handled by your organisation; the platform provides search and export to help locate data.

sama-monitoring.title: Security monitoring & event management
sama-monitoring.desc: Continuous monitoring with correlation-ready logs and alert history.

sama-availability.title: Availability & capacity management
sama-availability.desc: SLA reporting, capacity forecasts and business-hours availability metrics.

sama-audit.title: Audit trail & log retention
sama-audit.desc: Tamper-evident audit logs with long-term retention options.

sama-outsourcing.title: Outsourcing & third-party risk
sama-outsourcing.desc: In-Kingdom hosting and support, with documentation for your vendor-risk review.

sama-bcm.title: Business continuity
sama-bcm.desc: Documented RPO/RTO and DR testing evidence for your BCM programme.

sama-change.title: Change management evidence
sama-change.desc: Configuration change alerts and history to support change-control reviews.
